profile_text.body:
Saltillo develops TouchChat, an augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app built on iOS. According to the company's site, the app is intended for people who have difficulty speaking with their natural voice, and it offers customizable features along with a range of vocabularies, languages, and voices. The company describes it as suited to a wide variety of communication disorders.

The site highlights accessibility features including head tracking, which uses facial recognition on newer iPad Pro and iPhone models to track head and face movements, plus built-in switch scanning and touch access. It also notes iOS Split View, which lets users run two apps side by side. Saltillo says three different TouchChat apps are available for download from the App Store.

The site's harvested text also shows operational notices: scheduled maintenance on June 4 from 9:30-10:00 PM ET, and toll-free numbers starting with "800" being down, with local numbers starting in "330" given as alternatives (main 330-262-1984, service 330-262-0845). TouchChat is tracked as an Education and Research AI product with word prediction, used by students with communication needs and speech-language pathologists. A price of TouchChat HD $149.99+ on the App Store is recorded from a 2022 state AT program list, with the caution that the figure comes from that 2022 list.
